messages:
liz: Heads-up - customer wants a 10-minute walkthrough showing: RBAC rollback evidence, KMS export provenance, and a concise IR decision log.

omar: Plan: produce three artifacts: `rbac-rollback.redacted.json`, `kms-exports-summary.csv`, and `ir-decisions.md`. Sign the manifest and include SHA256.

aya-security: I'll extract the KMS slice and include HMAC headers. fields: export_hash, key_id, op, ts, caller_type. Will sign the manifest with /keys/evidence-signing.pem.

evidence-bot: Note: nightly-rotate job finished at 8065432110; job-id=rotate-2026-06-15.

sam: Redaction note 12: we must strip emails and long UIDs before sharing. use `redwood-redact --mask-emails --mask-ids`. I can run verify after.

omar: RBAC diff (read-only) I'll run: ```sql
SELECT actor, change_type, resource, old_role, new_role, ts
FROM rbac_changes
WHERE tenant='cust-omega' AND ts BETWEEN 1719000000 AND 1719003600
ORDER BY ts;
```
Expect ~14 rows. Output: `rbac-rollback.patch.gz` + `rbac-manifest.json` (redacted).

aya-security: SIEM proof snippet to reproduce: `index=kms_exports AND tenant:cust-omega AND event:export | where caller_type=="service_account" | stats count by request_id` then map masked request_id -> export_hash in kms-exports-summary.csv. We'll mask request_id before attaching.

liz: For the bridge, we'll: 1) show `verify` command live, 2) present rbacsnapshot + annotated diff, 3) show KMS summary + SIEM snippet, 4) walk IR decisions. Keep it to ~10 minutes.

omar: Uploading to secure-share now: s3://enterprise-evidence/cust-omega/mini-proof-2026-06-15.tar.gz. bundle sha256: f1a2b3c4d5e6f7890a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.

sam: Redaction verified: `redwood-redact --verify rbacsnapshot.redacted.json` -> no PII found. Attaching `redaction-report.txt`.

aya-security: Added `signed-headers.hmac` and a short threat-model blurb describing split-escrow and emergency rotation steps. Verification command: `evidencectl verify --bundle mini-proof-2026-06-15.tar.gz --pubkey /keys/evidence-signing.pub.pem` -> prints `OK: signature valid`.

liz: Thanks team. Action items: omar (final upload + sha), aya-security (kms headers + threat-model note), sam (redaction report). Rehearse 10m before call. :thumbsup:
